018package org.apache.hadoop.hbase.io.hfile.bucket;
019
020import static org.apache.hadoop.hbase.io.hfile.CacheConfig.BUCKETCACHE_PERSIST_INTERVAL_KEY;
021import static org.apache.hadoop.hbase.io.hfile.bucket.BucketCache.DEFAULT_ERROR_TOLERATION_DURATION;
022import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
023import static org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull;
024import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;
025
026import java.io.File;
027import java.io.FileOutputStream;
028import org.apache.hadoop.conf.Configuration;
029import org.apache.hadoop.fs.Path;
030import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.HBaseClassTestRule;
031import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.HBaseConfiguration;
032import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.HBaseTestingUtil;
033import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.io.hfile.CacheTestUtils;
034import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.io.hfile.Cacheable;
035import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.protobuf.ProtobufMagic;
036import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.testclassification.SmallTests;
037import org.junit.ClassRule;
038import org.junit.Test;
039import org.junit.experimental.categories.Category;
040
041/**
042 * Tests for HBASE-29857: BucketCache recovery should gracefully handle empty or truncated
043 * persistence files instead of throwing NullPointerException.
044 * <p>
045 * These tests verify that the cache recovers gracefully when the persistence file contains only
046 * magic bytes without actual cache data. The fix adds null checks that throw IOException instead of
047 * allowing NullPointerException to propagate.
048 */
049@Category(SmallTests.class)
050public class TestBucketCacheEmptyPersistence {
051
052  @ClassRule
053  public static final HBaseClassTestRule CLASS_RULE =
054    HBaseClassTestRule.forClass(TestBucketCacheEmptyPersistence.class);
055
056  private static final long CAPACITY_SIZE = 32 * 1024 * 1024;
057  private static final int WRITE_THREADS = BucketCache.DEFAULT_WRITER_THREADS;
058  private static final int WRITER_QUEUE_LEN = BucketCache.DEFAULT_WRITER_QUEUE_ITEMS;
059
060  /**
061   * Test that BucketCache recovers gracefully when the persistence file contains only non-chunked
062   * format (PBUF) magic bytes without any cache data. This tests the null check fix in
063   * retrieveFromFile() for the non-chunked format path.
064   */
065  @Test
066  public void testEmptyPersistenceFileNonChunkedFormat() throws Exception {
067    HBaseTestingUtil testUtil = new HBaseTestingUtil();
068    Path testDir = testUtil.getDataTestDir();
069    testUtil.getTestFileSystem().mkdirs(testDir);
070
071    Configuration conf = HBaseConfiguration.create();
072    conf.setLong(BUCKETCACHE_PERSIST_INTERVAL_KEY, Long.MAX_VALUE);
073
074    String persistencePath = testDir + "/bucket.persistence";
075    File persistenceFile = new File(persistencePath);
076
077    // Create a persistence file with only PBUF magic bytes - no actual cache data
078    try (FileOutputStream fos = new FileOutputStream(persistenceFile)) {
079      fos.write(ProtobufMagic.PB_MAGIC);
080    }
081    assertTrue("Persistence file should exist", persistenceFile.exists());
082
083    int[] bucketSizes = new int[] { 8 * 1024 + 1024 };
084
085    // BucketCache should recover gracefully from the empty file
086    BucketCache bucketCache =
087      new BucketCache("file:" + testDir + "/bucket.cache", CAPACITY_SIZE, 8192, bucketSizes,
088        WRITE_THREADS, WRITER_QUEUE_LEN, persistencePath, DEFAULT_ERROR_TOLERATION_DURATION, conf);
089
090    // Cache should initialize successfully (not hang or throw)
091    assertTrue("Cache should initialize successfully after recovering from empty file",
092      bucketCache.waitForCacheInitialization(10000));
093
094    // Verify the cache was reset (backing map should be empty since file had no valid data)
095    assertEquals("Backing map should be empty after recovering from empty persistence file", 0,
096      bucketCache.backingMap.size());
097
098    // Verify the cache is usable - we can add and retrieve blocks
099    CacheTestUtils.HFileBlockPair[] blocks = CacheTestUtils.generateHFileBlocks(8192, 1);
100    bucketCache.cacheBlock(blocks[0].getBlockName(), blocks[0].getBlock());
101
102    // Wait for block to be written to cache
103    Thread.sleep(100);
104
105    // Verify block can be retrieved
106    Cacheable retrieved = bucketCache.getBlock(blocks[0].getBlockName(), false, false, false);
107    assertNotNull("Should be able to retrieve cached block", retrieved);
108
109    bucketCache.shutdown();
110    testUtil.cleanupTestDir();
111  }
112
113  /**
114   * Test that BucketCache recovers gracefully when the persistence file contains only chunked
115   * format (V2UF) magic bytes without any cache data. This tests the null check fix in
116   * retrieveChunkedBackingMap().
117   */
118  @Test
119  public void testEmptyPersistenceFileChunkedFormat() throws Exception {
120    HBaseTestingUtil testUtil = new HBaseTestingUtil();
121    Path testDir = testUtil.getDataTestDir();
122    testUtil.getTestFileSystem().mkdirs(testDir);
123
124    Configuration conf = HBaseConfiguration.create();
125    conf.setLong(BUCKETCACHE_PERSIST_INTERVAL_KEY, Long.MAX_VALUE);
126
127    String persistencePath = testDir + "/bucket.persistence";
128    File persistenceFile = new File(persistencePath);
129
130    // Create a persistence file with only chunked format (V2UF) magic bytes - no actual cache data
131    try (FileOutputStream fos = new FileOutputStream(persistenceFile)) {
132      fos.write(BucketProtoUtils.PB_MAGIC_V2);
133    }
134    assertTrue("Persistence file should exist", persistenceFile.exists());
135
136    int[] bucketSizes = new int[] { 8 * 1024 + 1024 };
137
138    // BucketCache should recover gracefully from the empty file
139    BucketCache bucketCache =
140      new BucketCache("file:" + testDir + "/bucket.cache", CAPACITY_SIZE, 8192, bucketSizes,
141        WRITE_THREADS, WRITER_QUEUE_LEN, persistencePath, DEFAULT_ERROR_TOLERATION_DURATION, conf);
142
143    // Cache should initialize successfully (not hang or throw)
144    assertTrue("Cache should initialize successfully after recovering from empty file",
145      bucketCache.waitForCacheInitialization(10000));
146
147    // Verify the cache was reset (backing map should be empty since file had no valid data)
148    assertEquals("Backing map should be empty after recovering from empty persistence file", 0,
149      bucketCache.backingMap.size());
150
151    // Verify the cache is usable - we can add and retrieve blocks
152    CacheTestUtils.HFileBlockPair[] blocks = CacheTestUtils.generateHFileBlocks(8192, 1);
153    bucketCache.cacheBlock(blocks[0].getBlockName(), blocks[0].getBlock());
154
155    // Wait for block to be written to cache
156    Thread.sleep(100);
157
158    // Verify block can be retrieved
159    Cacheable retrieved = bucketCache.getBlock(blocks[0].getBlockName(), false, false, false);
160    assertNotNull("Should be able to retrieve cached block", retrieved);
161
162    bucketCache.shutdown();
163    testUtil.cleanupTestDir();
164  }
165}
